# Lock Ten Studio

> AI tools for the people who build custom homes, built and run by a working custom builder in Cabin John, Maryland. Three products: Walkthrough (a jobsite site-report app for builders), Architect Walkthrough (site reports and punch lists for architects) and The Install (a done-for-you AI-workspace setup for a builder's business). Plainspoken, no hype, made by someone who runs a build business.

## Products

- [Walkthrough](https://lockten.ai/walkthrough): an app for builders, on iPhone and Android. Walk a job site, talk and take photos, and it generates a clean PDF report you text or email to your subcontractor from your own phone. No portal and no logins for your subs, they just get a text. Photos save to your own Google Drive or Dropbox, not your camera roll. It handles walkthroughs, trade lists, owner updates, decision requests, meeting notes and a persistent punch list. Three free reports to start with every feature unlocked, no credit card, then two plans: Standard at $9.99 per user per month or $99.99 per year (every report type except meeting notes and the punch list, unlimited), and Pro at $24.99 per user per month or $239.99 per year (adds meeting notes and the persistent punch list). On the App Store and Google Play as "Walkthrough: Site Reports".
- [Architect Walkthrough](https://lockten.ai/architect): an iOS app for solo architects and small studios. Talk through a site visit and it drafts finished, editable documents in your studio's brand: site reports, living punch lists that stay checked-off across visits, client updates, meeting notes and quick photo-plus-question notes. Recipients just get a PDF by text or email, no logins. On-device transcription for reports and punch lists. First three sent reports free, then $19.99 per month or $199.99 per year. On the App Store.
- [The Install](https://lockten.ai/install): a done-for-you Claude Cowork workspace setup for a builder's business (your team, projects, voice and connectors, configured for you). Two tiers: Lite is free (the do-it-yourself package, email-gated download), Plus is $499 one-time (built for your specific business from a 25-minute questionnaire).

## About

Lock Ten Studio LLC, Cabin John, Maryland. The name refers to Lock 10 of the C&O Canal, a piece of 19th-century masonry engineering still standing. Contact: info@lockten.ai.
